target_customer: Consumers in Ecuador and Mexico buying medicines and personal care
problem: Buying medicine in Latin America was slow and pricey; FastFarma promised best price and 30 minute delivery from dark stores.
business_model: Online pharmacy retail margin with own delivery

exit.reason: Not stated by the company; Descubre.vc says commercial operations closed in 2023 and PitchBook lists out of business Oct 2023.

technical_complexity.rationale: App plus dark store logistics; operational complexity and pharmacy licensing rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: Incumbent chains like Fybeca and Cruz Azul already offered delivery and the model had thin retail margins.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Chains added delivery and pickup during the pandemic per Ecuadorian press; FastFarma closed in 2023.

market_need_then: Pandemic curfews pushed pharmacy delivery in Ecuador; Descubre.vc says it had about 2,800 customers a month at its peak.

branding.domain_note: fastfarma.com (not reachable at time of check).
branding.community_and_virality: Forbes Ecuador ran an item in Jan 2022 on the app launch (per Descubre.vc).

brand_strength.rationale: Name says speed plus pharmacy but is generic and shared with an unrelated Brazilian app; little press beyond launch coverage.

outcome_analysis: FastFarma ran dark store pharmacy delivery in Quito and Mexico City after YC Summer 2021, reaching roughly 2,800 customers a month by early 2022 per a directory. It closed commercial operations in 2023. The founders have not published a cause, so unit economics and fundraising failure are inferred from the thin margin model and small recorded funding.
notes: fastfarma.com DNS failure, treated as dead. Funding conflicts: CB Insights $130K seed Sep 2021; VCBacked $2.0M total with convertible note Dec 2021 and different investor names; Descubre says YC $125K plus convertible notes. Each recorded round rests on a single database and is unverified. Juan Carlos Holguin appears as co-founder in one listing only, so omitted. Competitors: only undated Ecuadorian press found, list empty. Cause of shutdown not public.
